text.note: An intentionally empty four-row description paired with each NO DATA heading.

text.reference: 新月時の神族を含む合体事故で出現
text.translation: Appears in a fusion accident involving Divine races during a new moon.

text.reference: 満月時の獣族を含む合体事故で出現
text.translation: Appears in a fusion accident involving Beast races during a full moon.

text.reference: 大天使・神獣の同種族2身合体で出現
text.translation: Appears through same-race double fusion of Heralds or Avatars.

text.reference: 妖精・龍王・鬼女の同種族3身合体か鬼神・龍神の同種族2身合体で出現
text.translation: Appears through same-race triple fusion of Fairy, Snake, or Femme; or double fusion of Kishin or Dragon.

text.reference: 妖魔・天使・妖鳥・魔獣の同種族3身合体か幻魔・霊鳥の同種族2身合体で出現
text.translation: Appears through same-race triple fusion of Yoma, Divine, Flight, or Beast; or double fusion of Genma or Avian.

text.reference: 夜魔・堕天使・妖鬼・地霊の同種族3身合体か聖獣・神樹の同種族2身合体で出現
text.translation: Appears through same-race triple fusion of Night, Fallen, Brute, or Jirae; or double fusion of Holy or Tree.

text.reference: レベル70以上の造魔とヴィシュヌの合体で出現
text.translation: Appears by fusing Vishnu with a Zoma of level 70 or higher.

text.reference: レベル65以上の造魔とショクインの合体で出現
text.translation: Appears by fusing Zhu Yin with a Zoma of level 65 or higher.

text.reference: レベル60以上の造魔とサンダルフォンの合体で出現
text.translation: Appears by fusing Sandalphon with a Zoma of level 60 or higher.

text.reference: レベル55以上の造魔とハチマンの合体で出現
text.translation: Appears by fusing Hachiman with a Zoma of level 55 or higher.

text.reference: レベル50以上の造魔とブラックマリアの合体で出現
text.translation: Appears by fusing Black Maria with a Zoma of level 50 or higher.
